description:
This process starts with a department outlining its objectives for the upcoming period, such as hiring, equipment needs, or marketing efforts.
The team drafts a plan that includes cost estimates and justifications for the budget requested.
The plan is first reviewed in a strategic alignment meeting to ensure it aligns with broader organizational goals.
Following this, the finance department performs a detailed review to assess the budget's feasibility.
The plan may undergo several rounds of review and possible adjustments based on feedback from these reviews.
Each adjustment is documented and approved by necessary stakeholders.
Once the final version of the budget is approved, the budget is officially allocated to the department.
The process ends when the budget is distributed, and the department begins implementing its plan.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BudgetPlanning" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/budget-planning">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BudgetPlanning" name="Department Budget Planning" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Objectives" name="Upcoming period begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Outline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Outline objectives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Outline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outline_Draft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Draft budget plan with cost estimates and justifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outline_Draft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Draft_StrategicReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicReview" name="Review strategic alignment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Draft_StrategicReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustmentApproval_StrategicReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Review budget feasibility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinanceReview_AdjustmentsGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentsRequired" name="Are adjustments required?" default="Flow_NoAdjustments">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinanceReview_AdjustmentsGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustmentsRequired</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdjustments</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdjustPlan" name="Adjust budget plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustmentsRequired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Adjust_Document</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Adjust_Document</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Document_ApproveAdjustment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustment" name="Obtain stakeholder approval for adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Document_ApproveAdjustment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustmentApproval_StrategicReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" name="Approve final budget">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdjustments</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Allocate budget to department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Allocate_Distribute</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeBudget" name="Distribute budget">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Allocate_Distribute</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Distribute_Implement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ImplementPlan" name="Begin implementing plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Distribute_Implement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Implement_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImplementationBegins" name="Department begins implementation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Implement_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Outline" sourceRef="StartEvent_Objectives" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outline_Draft" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Draft_StrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview" sourceRef="Task_StrategicReview" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceReview_AdjustmentsGateway" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsRequired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentsRequired" name="Adjustments required" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsRequired" targetRef="Task_AdjustPlan">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">adjustmentsRequired = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdjustments" name="No further adjustments" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsRequired" targetRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Adjust_Document" sourceRef="Task_AdjustPlan" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Document_ApproveAdjustment" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentApproval_StrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Distribute" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_DistributeBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Distribute_Implement" sourceRef="Task_DistributeBudget" targetRef="Task_ImplementPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Implement_End" sourceRef="Task_ImplementPlan" targetRef="EndEvent_ImplementationBegins"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
